title: MCP: claude shows tags instead of tool name
body: When using `/mcp` for listing remote tools, Claude recently shows tags instead of tool names. This makes selecting the right tool impossible. 1.0.51 (Claude Code) Claude: ``` ※ Tip: Ask Claude to create a todo list when working on complex tasks to track progress and remain on track ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ Tools for demo (43 tools) │ │ │ │ ❯ 1. Tags: Home Battery │ │ 2. Tags: Home Battery │ │ 3. Tags: Loadpoints │ │ 4. Tags: Loadpoints │ │ ↓ 5. Tags: Loadpoints ``` Same server as seen by `mcp-inspector`: This used to work in a previous Claude Code release. To reproduce, use https://demo.evcc.io/mcp
author: andig
